2-Room Apartment for Sale in Arabkir (N. Tigranyan Dead-End Street, "Ani" Newly Built Residential Complex)

The apartment is fully renovated and features 1 bathroom. It is equipped with all essential utilities: 24/7 water supply, gasification, electricity, a heating system, and high-speed internet access.
The "Ani" residential complex is situated in a quiet, safe, and well-developed part of Arabkir. All necessary infrastructure is nearby, including shops, supermarkets, schools, kindergartens, and public transport stops.
